title: PASCAL A Confusion Matrix
caption: PASCAL A (set_a) confusion matrices on EXP-B1 for M4, the best model by macro-F1. Left: counts over the folds of repeat 0, in which each of the 124 labelled records is predicted once. Right: row-normalized over every fold; the diagonal is per-class recall. Classes are in the fixed order normal, murmur, extrahls, artifact. `artifact` is a recording-quality label, not a cardiac class, so this is not a four-class cardiac classifier.
command: python scripts/38_result_graphs.py --figures G11 G12 G13 G14 G15 G16 G17
notes: PV-MEPCG / PulseVision is an academic screening prototype, not a diagnostic tool.
